theory.heading: What AWS Well-Architected Pillars is
theory.body: AWS Well-Architected Pillars describes the methods and patterns used within AWS Solutions Architect to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.

theory.heading: Why AWS Well-Architected Pillars matters
theory.body: Without AWS Well-Architected Pillars, systems built with AWS Solutions Architect are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How AWS Well-Architected Pillars works
theory.body: The mechanism behind AWS Well-Architected Pillars follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of AWS Well-Architected Pillars.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of AWS Well-Architected Pillars
theory.body: AWS Well-Architected Pillars offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
